decisions.reason: As a recently launched plugin that fits the firm's core shop-technology and analytics offering, management is likely to continue backing it because the investment is still fresh and any weak uptake can be interpreted as temporary market adjustment.

Despite sunk development effort, a Google Universal Analytics plugin is strategically hard to justify in 2024 because the underlying standard is obsolete, so disappointing results are no longer plausibly temporary.

A retail system interface plugin uses the firm's technical integration capabilities and supports its full-service e-commerce positioning, which makes management inclined to persist unless clear failure becomes unavoidable.

Because the relaunch SEO support service was given its own page and is closely tied to the firm's publicly presented service mix, management is likely to keep it and justify patience by pointing to delayed client adoption and project cycles.
